Pretupid Client 0.1.4 brings a new emote wheel, nametag styles and more control over your HUD colors. The Pretupid Launcher installs and updates it for you. Playing with another launcher? Drop the client jar into your `mods` folder next to Fabric API.

## What's new

### Emotes
- **Six-slot emote wheel:** the first six emotes are picked for you. Swap, replace or empty slots in *Cosmetics → Emotes*.
- **Nicer to use:** slots pop in, a pointer follows your mouse with a soft tick, and 1–6 play an emote straight away.
- **Stays open:** opening the wheel from the Quick menu no longer closes it right away.

### Nametag styles
- **Pick a style:** Sky, Sunset, Ocean, Neon, Gold, Rainbow, Flame and Aurora, each with its own colors and motion, right in *Cosmetics → Nametag*.
- **Always fresh:** new styles arrive without a client update.
- **Nothing lost:** if you had set up your own colors before, they stay available as *Your previous style*.

### HUD and modules
- **Module text color:** choose the color of HUD labels and waypoint names in *Settings → Interface*. It follows your interface color until you change it, and each module can still use its own.
- **Settings for every module:** every module now has a settings page, so you can give any of them a key to switch it on and off.
- **Up to four notifications:** notifications stack up to four at a time instead of disappearing before the next one arrives.

## Downloads
- **Client mod:** `pretupid-client-0.1.4+mc26.3.jar`
- **Source:** the source code archives below

The launcher updates Pretupid Client to 0.1.4 on its own, and the client offers the update in-game as well.
